teaser.en: A fat-stemmed succulent with showy pink trumpets, and sap poisonous enough to tip an arrow.
teaser.sw: Mmea wenye shina nene, maua ya waridi yenye umbo la tarumbeta, na utomvu wenye sumu kali ya kutosha kupaka mshale.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha madzi-madzi chenye kolo ra kufutuka na maruwa manono ga pinki ga umbo ra ndzumari, na maziya ga sumu kali hata ganaweza kutiywa kpwenye ntsa za mivi.

summary.en: Mwadiga is the desert rose, a succulent shrub with a swollen base and showy pink flowers, grown in gardens and found wild on dry rocky ground. Its latex is very poisonous and has been used in arrow poison.
summary.sw: Mwadiga ni mmea wenye shina lililovimba chini na maua ya waridi ya kuvutia, unaopandwa bustanini na pia kupatikana porini kwenye ardhi kavu yenye miamba. Utomvu wake una sumu kali sana na umewahi kutumiwa katika sumu ya mishale.
summary.dg: Mwadiga (kpwa Chingereza *desert rose*) ni chitsaka cha madzi-madzi chenye kolo ra kufutuka photsi na maruwa manono ga pinki. Nkuphandwa busitanini, na piya unaphahikana weruni kpwenye tsi kavu ya mawe. Maziyage ni sumu kali sana, na gakahumirwa kuhenda sumu ya mivi.

about.en: Mwadiga is a succulent shrub, usually under 2 m, whose stem base may swell into a bulbous trunk up to a metre across. Its fleshy, glossy leaves crowd at the branch tips, and white latex drips out at once when they are cut. The flowers are trumpet-shaped, about 5 cm across, white or pale pink to deep rose with darker edges, and are most striking on the bare stems. Paired, horn-like capsules split to free seeds with tufts of silky hair at each end. The Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: Mwadiga ni kichaka chenye majimaji, kwa kawaida chini ya m 2, ambacho sehemu ya chini ya shina lake huweza kuvimba na kuwa gogo la mviringo lenye upana wa hadi mita moja. Majani yake manene yanayong'aa hujikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi, na utomvu mweupe hutiririka papo hapo yanapokatwa. Maua yana umbo la tarumbeta, upana wa takriban sm 5, meupe au ya waridi hafifu hadi waridi iliyokolea yenye kingo za rangi nzito zaidi, na hupendeza zaidi yakiwa kwenye mashina yasiyo na majani. Matunda yake ni maganda mawili mawili yenye umbo la pembe, ambayo hupasuka kuachilia mbegu zenye vishungi vya manyoya laini kama hariri kila upande. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: Mwadiga ni chitsaka cha madzi-madzi, kpwa kawaida taufika mita 2. Photsi kolore rinaweza kufutuka na kukala dza chiazi chikulu, ambacho upanawe unaweza kufika mita mwenga. Makodzage ganona na ganang'ala, ganamera phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda, na gachikatwa maziya mereru ganadoda mara mwenga. Maruwage ni ga umbo ra ndzumari, upanawe sentimita 5 hivi; ni mereru, au ga pinki ngushu-ngushu hadi pinki sana, na kanda-kanda zao ni za rangi ya jiza zaidi. Ganaonekana manono zaidi gachimera dzulu ya panda zisizo na makodza. Makakaya mairi-mairi, dza pembe, ganaahuka na kuricha tembe zenye mafungu ga nyere laini kpwenye ntsa zosi mbiri. Adigo anaumanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows wild in hot, dry bushland and coastal hinterland woodland, often on rocky or gravelly ground, and does not tolerate waterlogging. It is also a popular garden and hedge plant.
where.sw: Huota porini katika vichaka vya joto na ukame na misitu ya bara karibu na pwani, mara nyingi kwenye ardhi yenye miamba au changarawe, na hauvumilii maji yaliyotuama. Pia ni mmea maarufu wa bustani na ua.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu yenye dzoho, na phatu phenye mihi kanda ya bara ya pwani, mara nyinji kpwenye tsi ya mawe au mtsanga wa mawe, na tauvumirira tsi inayoodzala madzi. Piya ni mmea unaomendzwa sana wa busitani na wa lichigo.

uses.en: ICRAF records the latex and roots as medicine, including for boils and venereal disease, with the warning that great caution is needed because the latex is very poisonous. The sap has been used as a component of arrow poison, pounded roots as a fish poison and pounded seeds or roots as rat poison. It is also planted as an ornamental and a live fence, and bees visit the flowers.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaripoti kwamba utomvu na mizizi hutumika kama dawa, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutibu majipu na magonjwa ya zinaa, kwa onyo kwamba tahadhari kubwa inahitajika kwa sababu utomvu wake una sumu kali sana. Utomvu umewahi kutumiwa kama kiambato cha sumu ya mishale, mizizi iliyopondwa kama sumu ya samaki, na mbegu au mizizi iliyopondwa kama sumu ya panya. Pia hupandwa kama mmea wa mapambo na ua hai, na nyuki hutembelea maua yake.
uses.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika kukala maziya na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa, kahi yao dawa ya maiphu na ya makongo ga zinaa, ela chinaonya kukala ni lazima atu akale makini sana, kpwa sababu maziya ni sumu kali sana. Maziya gakahumirwa dza seemu ya sumu ya mivi, mizi iriyobundugwa dza sumu ya kuolagira ng'onda, na tembe au mizi iriyobundugwa dza sumu ya kotso. Piya nkuphandwa dza mmea wa kupambira na dza lichigo, na nyuchi nkuphiya kpwenye maruwage.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwadiga, shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili; ICRAF confirms the same name in all four. The same Digo name is also given to the climber Rhynchosia congensis. In English it is the desert rose; its scientific name is Adenium obesum.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwadiga, linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili; ICRAF inathibitisha jina hilohilo katika lugha zote nne. Jina hilohilo la Kidigo pia hupewa mmea unaotambaa Rhynchosia congensis. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *desert rose*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Adenium obesum.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwadiga, rinarohumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili; chitabu cha ICRAF chinaonyesa dzina hiri hiri kpwa luga zosi nne. Libugu Rhynchosia congensis piya nkuihwa kpwa dzina hiri ra Chidigo. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *desert rose*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni Adenium obesum.

conservation.en: ICRAF warns that it is easily dug up by collectors for the ornamental trade and needs protection in the wild.
conservation.sw: ICRAF inaonya kwamba hung'olewa kwa urahisi na wakusanyaji kwa ajili ya biashara ya mimea ya mapambo, na unahitaji kulindwa porini.
conservation.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaonya kukala atu anaohala mimea kpwa biashara ya mimea ya kupambira nkuufukula upesi, kpwa hivyo unahitaji kurindwa weruni.

reason.sw: Chanzo kingine cha sumu ya mishale
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaolavya sumu ya mivi

reason.en: Yellow oleander, another poisonous ornamental of the same family
reason.sw: Mkode (yellow oleander), mmea mwingine wa mapambo wenye sumu wa familia hiyohiyo
reason.dg: *Mkode* (*yellow oleander*), mmea wanjina wa kupambira wenye sumu, wa jamii mwenga

reason.en: Another succulent of dry rocky ground
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wenye majimaji wa ardhi kavu yenye miamba
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa madzi-madzi wa tsi kavu ya mawe
